title: 第11章  对他疯狂心动第12章  季欢今晚你别哭
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
季欢此时的心底一片酸楚，原主的感情就是这样的。
她喜欢程永夜喜欢到疯狂，他一个眼神，她都能失控。
此时看着他搂着别的女人，她难过伤心了。
季欢也只能跟着一起悲伤难过。
程永夜见她低了头，又看了眼她桌上的食盒，吃的干干净净的，他嘴角勾了勾。
他就知道，她好这口，她的气应该都消了，他可以放心去忙工作了。
米湛一把抱住季欢的手。
“大明星朝我们看过来了，啊啊，他还对我笑了呢！好开心！”
季欢听着米淇激动的声音，她微拧着眉。
程永夜这家伙，也就那副皮囊长得完美了，见过他的女人都会对他动心！
程永夜离开后，差不多也到上班时间了。
白雾眠的工位就在季欢的边上，她不太喜欢季欢。
因为季欢是程永夜的好兄弟，一个雌性，怎么能被称作兄弟？
她理解的就是程永夜没把她当雌性看，而是把她当成雄性了。
但白雾眠就是不喜欢她，她不喜欢有别的雌性在程永夜的身边。
白雾眠敲了敲季欢的桌子。
“唉，季欢，我很喜欢永夜，以后我们也会结婚。所以，我希望你离他远一点，以后他说去接你，你就拒绝，可以吗？毕竟他是我男朋友，却总是先去见你，我会不高兴的。”
季欢应了一声，“好，我知道了。”
白雾眠见她答应了，脸色才好看点，她又开始工作。
季欢也在忙她的，最近有一个珠宝大赛，设计总监让她参加，算是她第一次以设计师的身份参加这样大型的比赛。

如果这次拿了奖，她就能跨入设计师行业了。
所以，季欢很用心，她在她那个世界也学这个专业的。
她也想成为一名优秀的珠宝设计师。
没想到，穿进小说里，也是一样的职业，而且这个时代的珠宝很受欢迎。
兽人从出生开始，就需要佩戴饰品，所以珠宝行业非常盛行。
这个时代原石发掘很多，所以没有假货，全都是真宝石，真金。
于季欢来说，这简直就是她大型的实践现场，等她回到她的世界，她就拥有一身的本领了。
这时，总监助理跟她们说。
“各位，请到三号会议室，总裁要跟总监一起给我们开会。”
米淇抱起桌上的东西，过来约季欢一起。
季欢把工作手机拿上，就跟着同事们一起去了会议室。
大家等了一会，设计总监蓝夜珂和总裁杨万理一起进到会议室。
杨万里对着白雾眠笑了笑，白雾眠对着她点了一下头。
所有人都朝她看了一眼，因为杨万里这个总裁，平时眼高于顶，只有总公司的高层他才放在眼里的。
没想到这位新来的员工，杨总对她点头哈腰的。
所有人都觉得这白雾眠应该来头不小。
两位领导落座后，蓝夜珂看向季欢。
“季欢，这次星际珠宝大赛由你参加，你的设计稿准备的怎么样了？”
季欢淡声回她。
“设计稿几乎完成了，我最近在选宝石，一周左右就能完成设计。”

蓝夜珂点头，“那刚好到比赛时间，干得不错。”
杨万里看了眼季欢，她也是新来不久，她毕业于帝王星大学，虽然是帝王星最高学府。
她算是高学历了。
可是与白雾眠比起来，还是差了点，白雾眠毕业于帝王星贵族学院。
光是她的这所学校，就能看出白雾眠是贵族出身。
content_en:
Ji Huan felt sad in his heart at this time, this was how the original owner felt.
She liked Cheng Yongye so much that she could lose control with just one look from him.
Seeing him hugging another woman at this time, she felt sad and heartbroken.
Ji Huan could only feel sad and sad together.
Cheng Yongye saw her lowering her head and looked at the food box on her table. She ate it cleanly, and the corner of his mouth curled up.
He knew that if she said this well, her anger should be gone, and he could go back to work without any worries.
Mi Zhan hugged Ji Huan's hand.
"The big star looked towards us, ah, he even smiled at me! So happy!"
Ji Huan frowned slightly as she listened to Mi Qi's excited voice.
This guy Cheng Yongye is so perfect because of his skin. Every woman who sees him will be attracted to him!
After Cheng Yongye left, it was almost time to go to work.
Bai Wumian's workstation is right next to Ji Huan, and she doesn't like Ji Huan very much.
Because Ji Huan is Cheng Yongye's good brother. How can a female be called a brother?
What she understood was that Cheng Yongye did not regard her as a female, but as a male.
But Bai Wumian just didn't like her. She didn't like having other females around Cheng Yongye.
Bai Wumian knocked on Ji Huan's table.
"Oh, Ji Huan, I like Yong Ye very much, and we will get married in the future. So, I hope you stay away from him. If he asks to pick you up, you can refuse, okay? After all, he is my boyfriend, but he always goes to see you first, and I will be unhappy."
Ji Huan responded, "Okay, I understand."
Seeing that she agreed, Bai Wumian's face looked better, and she started working again.
Ji Huan is also busy with her work. There was a jewelry competition recently, and the design director asked her to participate. It was her first time participating in such a large competition as a designer.
If she wins the award this time, she can enter the designer industry.
Therefore, Ji Huan is very attentive. She also studied this major in her world.
She also wants to be an excellent jewelry designer.
Unexpectedly, in the novel, it is the same profession, and jewelry of this era is very popular.
Orcs need to wear jewelry from birth, so the jewelry industry is very popular.
In this era, a lot of rough stones were excavated, so there are no fakes, they are all real gems and real gold.
For Yu Jihuan, this is simply her large-scale practice site. When she returns to her world, she will have all the skills.
At this time, the assistant director told them.
"Everyone, please come to conference room three. The president and the director will hold a meeting with us."
Mi Qi picked up the things on the table and came over to ask Ji Huan to join her.
Ji Huan took his work phone and followed his colleagues to the conference room.
After everyone waited for a while, design director Lan Yeke and president Yang Wanli entered the conference room together.
Yang Wanli smiled at Bai Wumian, and Bai Wumian nodded to her.
Everyone glanced at her, because Yang Wanli, the president, usually looked above the top, and only the top executives of the head office were in his eyes.
Unexpectedly, this new employee, Mr. Yang, nodded and bowed to her.
Everyone felt that Bai Wumian had a good background.
After the two leaders sat down, Lan Yeke looked at Ji Huan.
"Ji Huan, you are participating in this interstellar jewelry competition. How are you preparing your design draft?"
Ji Huan replied quietly to her.
"The design draft is almost completed. I am currently selecting gemstones and the design will be completed in about a week."
Lan Yeke nodded, "It's just game time. Well done."
Yang Wanli glanced at Ji Huan. She was also new here. She graduated from Emperor Star University, although it was the highest university in Emperor Star.
She is considered highly educated.
But compared to Bai Wumian, he was still a little behind. Bai Wumian graduated from the Noble Academy of Emperor Star.
Just from her school, it can be seen that Bai Wumian is from a noble family.
